nara.title: Nara Market Bid Analyzer
nara.description: AI pipeline that collects public procurement bids and scores their fit for your company
features: Auto-collects service & goods bids from Korea's G2B (Nara Market) API
2-stage LLM screening: title batch → full RFP PDF deep analysis
HIGH / MED / LOW fit scoring + strategic recommendations

detail.overview: An automation tool built to catch public procurement opportunities before they expire. It fetches new bids daily from the G2B public API, runs a fast batch screening in stage 1 (title + metadata), then downloads and deeply analyzes only HIGH/MED bids in stage 2 — extracting project scope and scoring fit against a company profile.
tasks: G2B API integration with pagination across multiple bid categories
Stage 1: GPT batch screening (HIGH / MED / LOW classification)
Stage 2: Auto PDF download → text extraction → project overview parsing
Deep analysis: fit score, strengths, risks, and proposal strategy
ThreadPoolExecutor-based parallel processing for speed
Customer profile customization support

rfp-writer.title: AI Proposal Draft Generator
rfp-writer.description: Upload an RFP PDF and LLM automatically extracts requirements and drafts each proposal section
features: RFP PDF parsing → auto requirements extraction & TOC structuring
Multi-agent debate to develop proposal strategy
Section-by-section draft generation with review & revision workflow

detail.overview: A Streamlit tool built to cut the time spent on proposal writing. Upload an RFP PDF and the LLM extracts requirements and table of contents, builds a slide structure, runs a two-agent strategy debate, then generates drafts for each section — with a built-in review and revision workflow.
tasks: RFP PDF parsing: requirement page detection and LLM-based extraction
TOC parsing or auto-generation for RFPs without a table of contents
Requirements ↔ slide mapping and coverage analysis
Multi-agent strategy debate (up to 2 rounds, with reference doc requests)
Streaming section draft generation (Q&A mode and outline mode)
Draft review and revision workflow
